_: Channel summaries, generated. Keyed by repo ("concordego" for ConcordeGo's notes), then a hash of the channel's source notes + tools/release-notes-prompt.md + the model (see channel_key in sync-releases.py). Written by tools/summarize-notes.py in the GitHub Action (model = the Claude model that wrote it) or by hand (model "hand"). Edit "bullets" freely: an entry is kept until its channel's notes change. "fold": true adds the closing "Plus smaller fixes and polish" line. An entry with "failed" is ignored by the page and asked again after 7 days; delete it to try sooner. Keep this file valid JSON: while it does not parse, nothing is summarized.

bullets: **Image generation** — ask for a picture and you get one; it runs on your Mac, or a cloud model fills in
**Model downloads** — progress reflects what is actually downloading and names each item; the preset that fits your disk is marked
**Enable visual effects** — replaces performance mode and now switches only the moving backdrop, not spinners and animations
**Check for updates automatically** — your choice: at launch and once a day, or only when you press the button
**Chat saving** — chats are now saved by the server, so they stop getting lost
Fixes to chat saving for rewinds, late answers, quitting with Cmd+Q and refused requests
**Windows** — chats, web search, read-aloud and voice input on Intel, AMD and ARM PCs; Ollama is installed for you
**Video and exports** — short clips rendered on your Mac, and answers saved in twenty formats, from PDF to slides
**Chats saved as you go** — questions and answers are kept even after Stop or quit; the 60-chat limit is gone
**Removed** — Contribute and the free community image cloud
**First-run setup** — builds your server on DigitalOcean end to end, or takes your own server's keys
**Automatic speed test** in Performance mode — re-runs when the network changes and every 30 minutes while connected
**Updates** — choose stable, beta or nightly in Settings; updates come as an offer you can skip, with What's new in About
**DNS** — NextDNS is optional, otherwise DNS runs encrypted via Cloudflare; Settings can flush the DNS cache
**Fast modes** — lock onto the connection the speed table lists as fastest
**Auto mode** — the speed line shows the last measurement, download and upload
**Kill switch** — while the tunnel is up, nothing gets around it; its self-test tells blocked from broken
**Server upkeep** — full OS updates for your servers from the app, and a warning on a server that isn't answering
**Speed** — Performance and Ultra use the fastest transport; the full test says if the VPN or your line is the limit
**Fixes** — apps that require encrypted DNS no longer stall, and switching off no longer strands open connections
**Round-trip fares** — return trips are now searched and priced
**Points and miles** — valued on the airlines' published award charts, with a transfer planner and real exchange rates
**Comfort grade** on every flight, lower when it falls below the cabin you asked for; 72 airlines rated per cabin
**Flight details** — journey bar, price history chart, who sells the fare, bag and add-on fees, lounge and meal info
